questions.prompt_html: \text{设}z=uv+\sin t, \text{而}u=e^{t},\ v=\cos t, \text{则全导数} \frac{dz}{dt}=()

options.label: A
options.html: \begin{aligned}e^t\left(\cos t + \sin t\right) - \cos t \, \leftrightarrow\end{aligned}

options.label: B
options.html: e^{t}\left(\cos t + \sin t\right) + \cos t

options.label: C
options.html: e^{t}\left(\cos t-\sin t\right)+\cos t

options.label: D
options.html: e^{t}\left(\cos t-\sin t\right)-\cos t\,.

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}\frac{dz}{dt} = \frac{\partial z}{\partial u} \frac{du}{dt} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial v} \frac{dv}{dt} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial t} = e^t \cos t - e^t \sin t + \cos t = e^t \left( \cos t - \sin t \right) + \cos t \, e^{-t} \end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{设}z=\frac{y}{x},\ \text{而}x=e^{t},\ y=1-e^{2t},\ \text{则}\frac{dz}{dt}=()。

options.label: A
options.html: - ( e ^ { t } + e ^ { - t } )

options.label: B
options.html: \boldsymbol{e}^{t} - \boldsymbol{e}^{-t} \, _{\leftarrow}

options.label: C
options.html: e^{-t} + e^{t}

options.label: D
options.html: e^{-t}-e^{t}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}\frac{d\bar{z}}{dt}=&\frac{-y}{x^{2}}\cdot x^{\prime}+\frac{1}{x}\cdot y^{\prime}=\frac{-y}{x^{2}}\cdot e^{t}+\frac{1}{x}\cdot (-2e^{2t})=-\bigl(e^{t}+e^{-t}\bigr)_{e}\end{aligned}

options.label: A

options.label: B
options.html: \frac{(1+x^{2})e^{\frac{1}{3}x^{3}}}{x+e^{\frac{1}{3}x^{3}}}\leftarrow

options.label: C

options.label: D

questions.prompt_html: \text{设}z=e^{x-2,y},\text{ 而}x=\sin t,\ y=t^{3}, \text{则} \frac{dz}{dt}=()

options.label: A
options.html: e^{\sin t - 2t^{3}}\left(\cos t - 6t^{2}\right)_{\leftarrow}

options.label: B
options.html: e^{\sin t - 2t^{3}}(\cos t - 3t^{2})

options.label: C
options.html: \left. \right) \ e^{\sin t-2t^{3}}\left( \cos t+6t^{2}\right) _{\leftarrow }

options.label: D
options.html: e^{\sin t - 2t^{3}}(\cos t + 3t^{2})

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}\frac{dz}{dt}=& \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} \frac{dx}{dt} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} \frac{dy}{dt} = e^{x-2y} \cdot 1 \cdot \cos t + e^{x-2y} \cdot \left(-2\right) \cdot 3t^2 \, , \\=& e^{x-2y} \left( \cos t - 6t^2 \right) = e^{\sin t - 2t^3} \left( \cos t - 6t^2 \right) .\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{设}z=uv+\sin t,u=e^{t},v=\cos t,\ \text{求} \frac{dz}{dt}=()。

options.label: A

options.label: B

options.label: C
options.html: \begin{aligned}e^t \cos t + e^t \sin t \, \lrcorner\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}\frac{dz}{dt} = \frac{\partial z}{\partial u} \cdot \frac{du}{dt} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial v} \cdot \frac{dv}{dt} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial t} = vu' + uv' + \cos t = e^t \cos t - e^t \sin t + \cos t \, e^{-t}\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{设}z=\arctan \left( xy \right),\ y=e^{x},\ \text{则}\frac{dz}{dx}=()。

options.label: B

options.label: C
options.html: \frac { 1 - x } { 1 + x ^ { 2 } e ^ { 2 x } } \Leftrightarrow

questions.analysis_html: \frac{dz}{dx} = \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} \frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{y}{1 + \left( xy \right)^2} + \frac{x}{1 + \left( xy \right)^2} \cdot e^x = \frac{e^x (1+x)}{1 + x^2 e^{2x}}

questions.prompt_html: \text{设} u = \frac { e ^ { a x } ( y - z ) } { a ^ { 2 } + 1 } , \ \ y = a \sin x , \ \ z = \cos x , \ \ \text{则} \ \frac { d u } { d x } = ( ) \text{。}

options.label: A
options.html: e^{ax}\sin x \leftarrow

options.label: B
options.html: e^{ax}\cos x

options.label: C
options.html: e^{ax}a\cos x

options.label: D
options.html: e^{ax}a\sin x

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}\frac{du}{dx} & = \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\frac{dy}{dx} + \frac{\partial u}{\partial z}\frac{dz}{dx} = \frac{ae^{ax}\left(y-z\right)}{a^{2}+1} + \frac{e^{ax}}{a^{2}+1} \cdot a\cos x - \frac{e^{ax}}{a^{2}+1} \cdot \left(-\sin x\right) \circ \\& = = \frac{e^{ax}}{a^{2}+1} \Big[ a^{2}\sin x - a\cos x + a\cos x + \sin x \Big] = e^{ax}\sin x \circ\end{aligned}
